disambiguation: Not a standard terminal emulator; it is specifically designed to run AI agent CLI sessions within Obsidian tabs.
extras: Only actively tested and supported on macOS.
problem: Users lack a way to run and manage multiple AI agent command-line sessions simultaneously within the Obsidian interface.
summary: A plugin that allows users to run and manage multiple AI agent CLI sessions, such as Claude or Gemini, directly within Obsidian tabs.
